title: Zapata and Villa: two leaders, two armies
goal: Tell the story of Zapata and Villa with the preterite and the imperfect.

items: I can tell a story in the past, with the preterite for events and the imperfect for the background.
I can say what the Plan of Ayala demanded and who Zapata was.
I can say who Villa was and what his army did.
I can use the words *el campesino*, *exigir*, *derrotar* and *la emboscada*.
